brief:
Lawyers for defendants in the Ulm 5 trial have called for a judge's recusal after an Israeli arms expert was barred from testifying, Middle East Eye reported. The witness, whose identity was not disclosed, had been set to give evidence in the case of activists accused of damaging an Elbit Systems facility that develops technology used in military operations in Gaza.

The exclusion of the expert witness prompted the defense team to question the judge's impartiality. The trial centers on allegations that the defendants damaged property at the weapons manufacturer's site in Ulm.
dek: Germany: Lawyers demand judge recusal in Ulm 5 trial after Israeli arms expert barred Submitted by Katherine Hearst on Thu, 11/05/2026 - 09:31 Witness blocked at trial of activists alleged to have damaged Elbit Systems site developing technology used in Gaza…
title: German lawyers seek judge removal over Israeli expert exclusion
